title: Disable a user account using the command line
summary: Use the `pwpolicy` command to disable a specific user account, preventing them from logging in. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Run the pwpolicy command with sudo to disable the specified user account.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The short name of the user account to disable

rollback.explain: To re-enable the user, use the enableuser flag with pwpolicy.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The short name of the user account to enable

warnings: Disabling an account prevents the user from logging in. Ensure you do not disable your own active admin account.
This does not delete the user's files, only their ability to log in.
